verification_method: Fresh complete remote-download SHA256 and exact byte verification for ordered parts and reconstructed complete ZIPs, with authenticated per-package receipts and independent source/control/file/remote-binding audit.
smk_representation_scope: 21 official Small STL sources plus the sole offered KAS19/6 STL. No additional higher-resolution Full/master file was obtained or is claimed. Exact selected representations are retained per source.
other_source_scope: Available unchanged Polycam native glTF/geometry/referenced images and Sketchfab distribution ZIPs retained with provenance. Container-derived GLBs preserve their documented lineage; no unpublished authoring-master claim.

control.includes: Frozen acquisition/selection/deduplication/readback metadata, offline gallery/thumbnails/server, portable private remote recovery map, source package manifests, signed source receipts, privacy checkpoints, exact cache-retirement journals and verification trust strategy.
control.excludes: Owner-only local signing key, ephemeral download URLs, active logs and post-completion proof summaries.

trust_strategy: Signing key remains owner-only locally; its non-secret fingerprint is archived. Restoration verifies ordered part/full ZIP/file SHA256 and bytes against the portable mapping and public control-ZIP hash anchor without needing the signing key. If the local key is lost, future cleanup requires fresh complete readbacks under a new owner-only key.
publication_status: Acquisition staged locally; this archive proof does not assert publication of the100 new works.
